title: Food Allergies
reuse: The FDA's website policies say that, unless otherwise noted, the contents of its website are not copyrighted, are in the public domain and may be republished, reprinted and otherwise used freely by anyone without permission. Credit is appreciated and not required.
taken: The names of the nine major food allergens. That the type of tree nut and the species of fish and of Crustacean shellfish must be declared. What the labelling law does not cover. That sulfiting agents must be declared from 10 parts per million. The page was current as of 11 March 2026.
